provenance.qualification: One concrete local path value replaced. Original bytes retained separately; no individual path-value digest included.

native_package_archive.qualification: Exact archive retained privately. Omitted from public transport because nested upstream ZIP/JAR assets were not decoded by the bounded scanner, and upstream metadata contains email candidates. Original archive checksum equals both child-lock entries. Public exact source members remain included.

verification: With explicit private archive/provenance inputs, the verifier checks original archive checksum, both member bytes, and exact one-field provenance reconstruction. Without them the packet verifies stored identities only and does not prove original-to-public replay or archive membership from the checksum alone.
